llm.evidence: TURN ENGINEERING INTO AI-NATIVE PRODUCTION GoGloby is an Applied AI Engineering partner.
llm.note: The first two sentences do not answer what is holding the reader’s AI engineering back; answer the H1 directly.
The page opens with a general engineering-delivery claim, not one of the three specified buyer problems; open with a stated buyer problem.

llm.evidence: We prove AI ROI. Every embedded team comes with the AI Intelligence Layer: every AI dollar visible, cost and return per shipped feature, month over month.
llm.note: The page leads with positioning and AI ROI rather than the hire, and introduces the Intelligence Layer before the assessment and guarantees; reorder the page as specified.
The page offers recruiting but does not identify GoGloby as a recruiting firm in its first lines; state that identity early.

llm.evidence: The AI Intelligence Layer connects AI spending with engineering work. It shows what work costs, where AI is being used, and how those numbers change against the team’s baseline.
llm.note: The FAQ answers are direct and can be understood when quoted individually.
